title: Macro / Regime Mini-Panel
subtitle: Synthetic fixture for display-first visual artifacts; not live market data
summary: Rates pressure is the main constraint; volatility and credit are not blocking risk.
source: fixture; Source Routing Boundary; Longbridge macrodata allowed for authorized series; official / reputable confirmation required for policy/news

variables.name: 10Y
variables.label: 10Y Treasury yield
variables.interpretation: Near 4.50% pressure line; higher yields cool QQQ/SOXX high-beta setups.
variables.impact_path: rates -> growth multiple -> QQQ/SOXX/AI hardware risk budget

variables.name: 30Y
variables.label: 30Y Treasury yield
variables.interpretation: Close to 5.00%; long-duration growth multiple risk stays elevated.
variables.impact_path: long-end yields -> duration pressure -> AI beta and LEAP risk

variables.name: VIX
variables.label: Equity volatility
variables.interpretation: Below 20 supports balanced risk, but it is not a standalone buy signal.
variables.impact_path: volatility -> position sizing -> 0DTE and high-beta exposure

variables.name: NDX/RUT
variables.label: Large-cap growth vs small-cap breadth
variables.interpretation: Rising ratio means leadership remains narrow; broad risk-on needs better small-cap follow-through.
variables.impact_path: NDX divided by RUT -> breadth quality -> narrow vs broad risk-on

variables.name: SMH/SPY
variables.label: Semiconductor relative strength
variables.interpretation: AI hardware remains the active leadership theme if rates do not keep rising.
variables.impact_path: semis relative strength -> theme leadership -> AI hardware candidate pool

variables.name: HYG/LQD
variables.label: Credit risk appetite
variables.interpretation: Credit tone is not blocking risk, but it does not offset yield pressure by itself.
variables.impact_path: credit appetite -> risk liquidity -> equity beta confirmation

notes: Fixture only; live use must cite the authorized source for each series.
Macro visual summarizes regime pressure/support; it does not generate trade triggers.
Policy/news items should be included only after official or reputable confirmation.
